rationale: Plan addresses all three failed evaluation checks: (1) denial_rate denominator changed from 'all_claims' to 'adjudicated_claims' to exclude Pended claims and compute the rate over only decided claims (Paid, Denied, Adjusted), matching the golden definition; (2) monthly_trend date_column changed from 'adjudication_date' to 'service_date_from' to reflect when care was delivered rather than when claims were adjudicated, eliminating temporal inconsistency. All other components remain unchanged to maintain coverage of task requirements.
changes_summary: Two critical corrections from feedback: (1) denial_rate denominator changed to 'adjudicated_claims' to properly exclude pending claims and compute the rate over only adjudicated claims (Paid, Denied, Adjusted); (2) monthly_trend date_column changed to 'service_date_from' to key the monthly volume trend on service delivery dates rather than adjudication dates, which lag service delivery and create inconsistency.
